claimBoundary: A successful render is not by itself a theorem about transport, a biological reconstruction, intelligible speech, or listener perception.

items: The guitar is a signal model (waveguide strings, pickup-position combs, a coil-and-cable resonance under a tone knob, hum): not an Ariadne World and not under the pure-physics constitution; only what it drives is.
The World's Output stage clamps at +-1 (the plug-in's safety limiter), and the runaway guard fades and rests the World when it is held there.
The canonical World's controls are the plug-in's twenty parameters; their behaviour is the plug-in's (ovillo_dsp::ariadne, lifted line for line).

output.about: the bench's master (monitor) is at unity; its runaway guard may fade the output (telemetry guard)
output.observes: the World's stereo listener times Listener Scale, mixed with the DI by Mix, times Output, safety-limited at +-1 (the plug-in's own stages)

outputDigestCovers: every frame rendered, interleaved left/right, f32 little-endian

world.simulatedGuitar: a signal model (not a World): its DI drives the World
